screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished in-game screenshot concept for a serious, restrained mobile hospital simulation named 梅奥. This is screen 01 in a coherent set. Landscape mobile game screen, approximately 2:1, edge-to-edge game world, NO device frame, NO montage.
Scene: first morning of a small professional clinic in a town on the edge of a large Chinese city. A believable rented streetfront unit approximately 140 square meters, visible sidewalk, modest storefront sign reading exactly "梅奥诊所". Orthographic isometric 2.5D cutaway: roofs removed, near walls cut low to reveal rooms, back walls full height. One equipped general consultation room, one EMPTY future room with only a folded chair and boxed supplies, modest reception desk, six waiting chairs, small nursing/preparation area, handwashing sink and toilet. Coherent doors and circulation; rooms connect to a walkable corridor. Show one doctor in consultation, one nurse preparing materials, a receptionist, four varied adult patients doing ordinary quiet things. Normal adult proportions, no caricatures. All furniture correctly scaled.
Art direction: believable premium simulation game art with clean crafted geometry and softly painted materials, architectural precision, legible at phone scale; NOT photorealistic aerial photography, NOT cute toy diorama, NOT glossy plastic, NOT voxel or pixel art. Warm ivory walls, pale gray terrazzo, muted sage medical cabinetry, dark blue-gray uniforms and signage, natural light from street glazing, restrained warm morning light, subtle shadows. Hospital scene should occupy at least 90 percent of frame. Mostly clinic interior with a small slice of the surrounding town, no excessive empty grass.
UI is minimal, tactile and genuinely game-like. Small unobtrusive top-left text "梅奥" and "第 1 天"; top-right compact "08:20" and "¥180,000". Bottom-left three small square pictogram controls with exact short Chinese labels "医院" "团队" "事务", dark desaturated blue backing, ample finger spacing. Bottom-right a discreet zoom control. No speedup control because this game progresses equally online and offline. All type crisp, small but readable. NO dashboard cards, NO web/app landing-page composition, NO sidebar, NO paragraphs, NO giant title, NO promotional headline, NO achievement banners, NO floating coins, NO exclamation bubbles, NO neon gradients, NO KPI tiles. Quiet observation of an actual operating clinic is the hero. Do not add captions outside the screen.

Opposite the entrance a coherent ambulance arrival route, one parked ambulance outside. Two doctors, several nurses, around 12 adult patients and visitors distributed realistically. Show some rooms active, some empty, no crisis chaos. Outside is a small strip of town streets and trees. Dusk blue through windows balanced by warm interior practical lighting: the institution is still working while the city grows dark. Cutaway walls must reveal rooms without giant obstructing facades. Screen edges only: top-left "梅奥医院", small "第 186 天"; top-right "19:40" and "¥2,860,000"; bottom-left same three controls as reference, exact labels "医院" "团队" "事务"; bottom-right same discreet zoom. No other interface panels. This should feel satisfying to watch quietly and carefully constructed over time. Do not reproduce any promotional wall writing from the reference.
